notes.title: So. 2026. 10 years, huh?
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/4cdf4cc9e1a147d4110ef4c3a1c70bed0f131919.png[/img]

Hot on the heels of saying that we're only working on one singular project next year..... well, we didn't lie. Exactly. We're not currently planning on working on a second project for 2026 as of now.

But.

Next year is our 10th year of not going out of business, and we would really love to do *something*. Some sort of 10th Anniversary Edition of some game - obviously, with new stuff. New story. New content. It's not our style just to do the same thing over again (*pushes the Black Goat of the Woods Editions under the rug*). 

Would people want to see an Army of Tentacles 10th Anniversary Edition or a Paper Shakespeare 10th Anniversary Edition?

notes.title: Steg Stuff, 8.15.2025
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/7a3d0cb9073d8dc91a63e62dcd22e93c3c85c831.png[/img]

Due to the rest of the year getting unbelievably, ungodly busy within the past two weeks, everything has been pushed back. [b]Hamlet[/b] and [b]Dino Shakes[/b] will still come out this year, but [b]Dino Shakes[/b] just is not able to launch next month anymore now that so much medical stuff is going on basically every other week back to back. 

"Teehee tehee, I'll just make three small hand drawn games to close out 2025".... yeah. LOL.

The [b]Scarecrows[/b] rewrite will come out in 2026. There will be no other projects besides this one for next year. We'll talk about that one..... probably next year. We know that 2026 is our 10 Year, but as of now, we don't really have anything set up for a 10 Year launch. 

There's just too much going on, fam.

notes.content:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245540/Tentacle_Prawn_Actually_A_Cthulhu_Dating_Sim_New_Game_Benefits_HD/?beta=0

The final DLC for Tentacle Prawn is out now, and for some reason, this post did not out last night! Never fear, for now it [i]has[/i].

Rewritten and recoded about three times, it now exists as sort of an Epilogue-Dev Diary hybrid. With choices! And characters that you might not have seen since Super Army of Tentacles 3 (but who have aged in real time because that's the kind of detail gamers notice, right?). 

What shall become of the Old Gods now that they have returned to the past to right the wrongs of.... the past? Will they be fated to return to the dating sim dimension once more? Will anyone kiss? Is kissing still a thing? These are important questions that need answers hammered out before the new world order becomes the new world order.

notes.title: Shakespeare's Birthday Sale 2025!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/f0773cdde99c1f4a89213af6fe6643c6c85ccade.jpg[/img]

[b]Happy May 12th, everybody! [/b] Yes, it is another sale. Yes, it is not April, when Shakespeare's birthday actually is. That was going to be the first of two things, but I started writing before I made the list, so here we are.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/8b396e5c5f64323c7346a9181402a495601e809e.png[/img]

The second thing is that you may notice our sale strategy is a bit different this time around. We're trying out new numbers, testing out new DLC pricing to see if it moves that needle at all. 

Ten year ago, [b]Army of Tentacles 1[/b] was greenlit. A year after that, we had sold over 400 copies on Steam. Eight years ago, we decided to make every Shakespeare play into a game. We're two games away from that goal.

So, come one, come all, and peruse our fine (90%) anthropomorphic wares. It's what the Bard would have wanted. No, seriously, Shakespeare probably would be writing a furry webcomic.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/90a23201019a33da05b4a23794a6193eb4fca029.png[/img]

It's ALSO the Critter Collector Fest right now on Steam, and so that means.... well, it really just means another game on sale. But WHAT A GAME IT IS. 

A full-blown feline battle academy set in a San Francisco ravaged by tech lords (ok, so....), all legally distinct from the most popular creature collector out there!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/1b34f23748334c1d36ff63f30e381c7b201aa268.png[/img]

Next year is our 10 Years of Not Going Out of Business Sale. Life is nuts.

notes.title: GEEKS 2: Prince Change Incoming.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/f0eaecd0a3c091866bed827ed7d936ae859ebb89.png[/img]
There's a price change incoming to Geeks 2. Right now, it's at 99 cents. We're trying to make it free. The reason being because we got all of the AI art out of the game, therefore we don't see the point in selling a game using entirely reused assets. 

AI has no use in art, and the fact that we let it slip by was naive, stupid, incredibly brazen, and entirely unprofessional.

We're going to be publishing some new donation DLC (most likely next month), which most likely will include some new scenes using new assets.

notes.title: GEEKS 2 now only 99 cents.
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/f0eaecd0a3c091866bed827ed7d936ae859ebb89.png[/img]

We recently changed the price of [b]GEEKS 2[/b] from $4.99 to .$99. We did so because, at the time of publishing, we had backgrounds that we thought were okay to use, so we paid for them and put them in the game. We recently got all of the AI out of the game, and as such, drastically lowered the price due to this. 

I'm going to be clear. We do not advocate for the usage of AI in art, and using some for backgrounds, even though we trusted the artist, was incredibly stupid and brazen. 

Next month, we will be adding in a few small scenes to the game to justify why the title still has a price tag.

notes.title: Army of Tentacles: Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island out next week!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/dd6174258fdf2eae7a5947b689cd866e93b420a0.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877720/Army_of_Tentacles_Assault_on_Rainbow_Unicorn_Island/
So. Time to talk turkey. 

[b]Army of Tentacles: Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b] is going to come out next Tuesday.

This game in no way should have taken as long as it did to come out. But that's the life of an indie dev company, especially if you want full VO in your game. 

The game's VO will be patched in at a later date. We already lost one backup of the VO files, and now the secondary may very well perish in the San Diego fires.

I'd rather not worry about video game bullshit right now. I'd rather focus on making sure my team is safe and not burning to cinders, or wondering where they are going to live in a few days. I'd rather they focus on that. Hell, they would rather they focus on that.

So, VO will be patched in at a later date.

notes.title: AoT: Unicorns = Halloween 2024? Spooky Cat Girls 2 = Halloween 2025?
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/49ea5eb7e0e593edcb0495724de2d5a9fd62910c.jpg[/img]

Without going into my personal junk, about five to six life events hit me at the end of last year, one of which I had been prepping for. I/We already had decided to only work on Dinosaur Cousin Squad until it was ready for internal beta testers (which should be in the next few weeks), but with everything else that hit, it left me very emotionally drained. That and then you add in the Brain Fog, a loving reminder of my two bouts with COVID-19. 

The point is that I'm thinking of moving [b]Spooky Cat Girls 2[/b] to later, if not Halloween 2025. [b]Army of Tentacles: Assault on Unicorn Island[/b], if not out by then, would take its place as the Halloween 2024 game. I do not think there is any reason other than current lethargy that [b]AoT: Unicorns[/b] would land on Halloween 2024. 

[b]Cat Girls: IMT[/b] is looking good, but as stated, [b]DCS[/b] takes priority, and even if we barreled through it before SDCC in late July, we still wouldn't feel comfortable releasing it until at least December, if not later (for personal reasons as well as wishlists). 

We might do some weird, smaller game after [b]DCS[/b] level rough draft is done but before SDCC. [b]AoT: Christmas Edition[/b] has been thrown around just cause we were playing Lemmings: Christmas Edition last night. It would probably use the remaining art for Tentacle Prawn that we just never ended up using.

notes.title: Announcing the 2/4 Final Shakes Games!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/02a5f8c562f20acc023c1a5d56ae25ee7566f9d0.jpg[/img]
While progress on [b]Dinosaur Cousin Squad[/b] is going well (despite hitting an error as soon as we booted up the base code for the first time as one complete package), we were able to at least get a good foothold on two of the final four Paper Shakespeare games while waiting on the base code. We are very happy to be able to share the store pages with you today:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2762590/Furry_Shakespeare_To_Date_Or_Not_To_Date_Cat_Girls_If_Made_Today
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757940/Furry_Shakespeare_To_Date_Or_Not_To_Date_Spooky_Cat_Girls_2

[b]Cat Girls? If Made Today[/b] isn't a remake, but rather, a reimagining of the game if it was made with the game dev know-how that we have now, and with the storytelling and gameplay that we want to do. This is the first Cat Girls game as if it was completely unconnected to the other games, as the Keegan Quinn/Multiverse BS storyline is over. 

[b]Spooky Cat Girls 2?![/b] is another experimental title: it is three spooky games in one. The first is the titular Spooky Cat Girls, the second is a Cthulhu Dating Sim that we've been calling the Dark Souls of Visual Novels, and the third is our Kaiju game. 

Neither have solid dates yet, as we need to both launch [b]Army of Tentacles: Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b], as well as dedicate our time to finishing up Dinosaur Cousin Squad in time for Christmas - or before.

We hope you enjoy.

notes.title: The FINAL FIVE SHAKESPEARE + DCS update!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/a3690f55b8af0f5dccbcfd45c9c724daf41ba655.gif[/img]
The mad quest to make a game for every Shakespeare play is swiftly reaching its promised end, with the first being Army of Tentacles: [b]Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b]. After that, maybe we can sleep. 

Two are scheduled for the end of 2024, but the majority of work on those will commence after [b]Dinosaur Cousin Squad[/b] has dropped. We don't yet know when that one will have a Store Page up, but we assume within the next few months. Both games were being prepped while Dinosaur Cousin Squad was being worked on, but DCS progress has hit a few fun new snags, so we might be able to finish before proper level clean-up is set to begin in a few months. 

The final two are set for early and late 2025. One is a collaboration, and the other is another new engine, new genre game..... this time: a tRPG deck builder. In layman's terms, a party based tactical RPG with a card system. We've very recently begun pre-production and asset buy on that one. 

Store pages for at least two of the final four adaptations will be popping up after [b]Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b] drops on the 23rd.

notes.title: A note about AI art in our games.
notes.content:
So, for a few smaller games in the past (including tomorrow's Dinos Shakespeare 2 DLC), we have used AI backgrounds. We had both in-house discussions about it, as well as extensively made sure that the singular artist we used for said games was being ethical in what she fed her AI. 

[b]Scarecrows[/b] came out, and at the time, we assumed the generated art was made using the same level of care (as their prior art that we used from the same artist was painted), and while we have no reason to believe otherwise and do not wish to slander said artist, we will be working to attain new background art for [b]Scarecrows[/b]. This might look like a combination of new and existing art or it might be new art altogether. Regardless, it will not happen overnight.

We will not be using AI art of any kind in any future games. We apologize to both our fellow developers as well as our customers for any ill will gained via our actions.

notes.title: DCS Delay
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/b538c215a068aee39afe1b27c3543c6a0546caf4.gif[/img]
Due to increased stress due to family medical issues and my own medical issues, [b]Dinosaur Cousin Squad[/b] has been delayed until sometime next year. We're fast tracking a game that we intended to work on for next Halloween in order to fill its place, as well as working on the DLC sequels that we were going to do for early next year.

DCS could potentially be done by the rest of the team, but because it is the first game of ours in a new genre and engine, plus since I originally started making it as a Christmas present for my younger cousins, I'm trying to be as hands-on as I possibly can be. That just is not possible given my current stress levels from real life currently coming at me from all sides.

I promised them this game two Christmas Day's ago. Ugh. Well, it's going to be great when it comes out. This also gives us the chance to give the game a decent lead-in with a Coming Soon page, rather than just putting one up a few weeks before launch during the busiest time of the year.

So there's the trick. The treats are coming soon.
